attempts.sql:
SELECT f.file_id, f.line_count
FROM code.files f
WHERE regexp_matches(f.file_id, '^rich/[^/]+\.py$')
  AND f.line_count >= 100
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM code.files t
    WHERE t.is_test
      AND (regexp_matches(t.file_id, '^rich/test_[^/]+\.py$') AND t.file_id = regexp_replace(f.file_id, '^rich/', 'rich/test_'))
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM code.imports i
    JOIN code.files t2 ON t2.file_id = i.file_id
    WHERE i.imported_file_id = f.file_id
      AND t2.is_test
  )
ORDER BY f.file_id

request:
Which Python files sitting directly in the rich/ folder (not in its subfolders) are at least 100 lines long yet have no test file associated with them, where a test is associated when it imports the file or its name is test_<filename>.py? Give the file path and its line count.

Requested output columns: file_id (string), line_count (integer).
explanation: Finds Python files directly under rich/ (path matches rich/<name>.py with no subdirectories) whose line_count is at least 100. It then excludes files that are imported by any test file, and also excludes files whose sibling test_<filename>.py exists. The remaining files are returned with their paths and line counts.
sql:
SELECT f.file_id, f.line_count
FROM code.files f
WHERE regexp_matches(f.file_id, '^rich/[^/]+\.py$')
  AND f.line_count >= 100
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM code.files t
    WHERE t.is_test
      AND (regexp_matches(t.file_id, '^rich/test_[^/]+\.py$') AND t.file_id = regexp_replace(f.file_id, '^rich/', 'rich/test_'))
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM code.imports i
    JOIN code.files t2 ON t2.file_id = i.file_id
    WHERE i.imported_file_id = f.file_id
      AND t2.is_test
  )
ORDER BY f.file_id
